title: Mycelix / hAppRadar interoperability decision matrix

scope.statement: Comparative design guidance only. No external project is asserted to be integrated, secure, production-ready, or compatible with the current Mycelix runtime.

excluded_default_target.reason: Development prerelease is not the stable default qualification target.

migration_constraints: 0.6 Action/validation APIs differ from the 0.7 ActionData/FlatOp model.
0.7 removes tx5/WebRTC and uses Iroh over QUIC.
There is no built-in 0.6 conductor database migration path; DNA hashes change and 0.7 cannot read 0.6 databases.
User-data continuity, where required, needs a separately qualified application-level export/import/recovery process.
holochain_compatibility_baseline.repository_baseline_note: The Mycelix root README observed during this review still describes a 0.6 baseline; subprojects may have independent migration work. Qualification must be per deployable hApp.

decision_rules: A project listing, README claim, build, unit test, API response, signature, or live demo is not by itself proof of production readiness, security, adoption, or DHT validation.
Use external vocabularies for interoperable facts; preserve Mycelix identity, authorization, monetary-policy, and settlement invariants.
Every adapter must declare its exact source revision, toolchain tuple, data direction, trust boundary, license-review status, and claim ceiling.
Unknown, stale, conflicting, unavailable, or unsupported evidence must remain explicit; do not silently coerce it to valid, false, trusted, or settled.

projects.name: hREA
projects.useful_capability: ValueFlows/REA vocabulary and Holochain-backed economic coordination.
contract: Map resources, commitments, intents, claims and economic events without treating them as interchangeable.
Preserve exact asset identity, integer quantity and units, issuer/community scope, provenance and correction lineage.
Imported events do not authorize SAP/TEND mutation or settle an obligation by themselves.
blocking_evidence: Pinned artifact and license review.
Exact conductor/HDK/HDI/client/adapter tuple.
Round-trip and malformed/unknown-field controls.
Two-agent test on the qualified stack.

caveats: The release tag and its two asset digests are pinned as research evidence, but neither artifact has been selected as a Mycelix dependency.
The separately pinned sprout source branch head is a later commit than the release tag; source-tree state must not be substituted for released artifact evidence.
Mycelix Finance's reviewed dependency tuple remains on the Holochain 0.6 line; no native DNA composition or runtime integration is qualified.
observed_maturity_and_compatibility.use_for_mycelix: Prefer a read-only, versioned export first. For any native composition experiment, pin the hREA DNA/hApp artifact and full client/adapter/conductor tuple, review license and migrations, and test on an isolated branch with exact round-trip and two-agent controls.

projects.name: Nondominium
projects.useful_capability: Resource-scoped peer networks and private participation receipt patterns.
contract: Group membership or a receipt does not grant authority over another resource/network.
Compare ownership, participation receipt, resource lifecycle and recovery semantics before defining common types.
blocking_evidence: Exact branch/artifact/toolchain capture.
Access-boundary comparison and cross-group negative controls.
License and source-reuse review.

projects.name: Moss
projects.useful_capability: User-composable collaboration tools and separate private group/tool contexts.
contract: Keep modular user experience separate from network isolation.
A unified deployment must not be the only composition option or default authorization boundary.
blocking_evidence: Pinned source and license review.
Prototype tool boundaries and user recovery before claiming interoperability.

projects.name: AD4M
projects.useful_capability: Agent-centric semantic relationships, signed expressions and pluggable language adapters.
contract: Preserve signer, provenance, schema/language version and interpretation context.
A signature or semantic relation proves neither truth nor permission to act.
blocking_evidence: Pinned protocol/version.
License compatibility review.
Equivocation, revocation, schema-drift and authorization-boundary tests.

projects.name: ValiChord
projects.useful_capability: Commit/reveal rounds for pre-registered, independently collected evaluations.
contract: Use canonical, versioned, domain-separated preimages and identical encode/hash logic.
Reject phase violations, mismatches and replay; preserve disagreement.
Commitment integrity is distinct from truth, competence, quorum legitimacy and Sybil resistance.
blocking_evidence: Threat model for evaluator collusion and issuer trust.
Multi-agent tests for tamper, replay, dropout, delay and conflicting outcomes.

projects.name: Epistemic Resonance Protocol
projects.useful_capability: Structured claims, critiques and evidence with visible disagreement.
contract: Keep claims, sources, critiques, revisions and dispositions attributable and versioned.
Do not replace claim evaluation with reputation or collapse disagreement into one consensus value.
blocking_evidence: Schema and claim-ceiling review.
Tests for unsupported claims, source changes, retraction and unresolved disagreement.

observed_maturity_and_compatibility.declared_runtime: The hAppRadar page describes a standalone desktop app with a built-in Holochain 0.7 conductor, while its structured Holochain-version field is not recorded.
caveats: Desktop release assets are reported as unsigned by the project page.
INSTALL documentation says peer discovery currently uses Holochain's development bootstrap server.
The project states data does not survive an incompatible upgrade; do not assume in-place data migration.
observed_maturity_and_compatibility.use_for_mycelix: Good evidence of a standalone distribution approach and append-only claim/critique/retraction model; not proof of production deployment, independent security review, or stable peer-discovery infrastructure.

projects.name: Hearth
projects.useful_capability: Person-controlled care records and portable care preferences.
contract: Make consent, delegation, revocation, export and recovery understandable.
Do not use demo/research installations with real health information.
blocking_evidence: Current maturity and threat-model review.
Privacy, retention and interoperability-profile review.

caveats: The project's own README describes an early demo and says it should not be relied on for real care records.
The reviewed project page says stored entries are not encrypted at rest.
Members admitted to a circle receive plaintext, and leaving removes the local copy only; other circle members retain theirs.
It explicitly is not a clinical record.
observed_maturity_and_compatibility.use_for_mycelix: Benchmark person-centred consent and portability UX only; do not import its storage/security model or test with real health data.

projects.name: Flowsta Vault
projects.useful_capability: Local custody, visible action approval, backup and user export/recovery.
contract: Sensitive actions must be visible, scoped and explicitly approved.
Recovery/export must not depend on an operator holding the only copy of data or credentials.
blocking_evidence: Pinned source and dependency/license metadata review.
Threat model for local bridge, key derivation, backup and restore.

projects.name: Requests and Offers
projects.useful_capability: Narrow request/offer journey and explicit test-pyramid examples.
contract: Prove request → offer → commitment → completion evidence → settlement with cancellation, dispute and recovery.
Keep claimed, agreed, performed, evidenced and settled states distinct.
blocking_evidence: Pin exact Holochain/hREA artifacts and client/adapters.
Real-conductor multi-agent, retry/replay and user-flow tests.

caveats: The project explicitly labels itself alpha/not production-ready.
Its listed compatibility tuple differs from the Holochain 0.7 baseline in this matrix.
observed_maturity_and_compatibility.use_for_mycelix: Benchmark the narrow user journey and tests, but do not assume an artifact is directly composable with hREA's Holochain 0.7 branch.

adversarial_cases.input_condition: A Holochain 0.6 artifact or database is presented as a qualified 0.7 target.
adversarial_cases.reason: Action model, DNA hashes and conductor database compatibility differ; no built-in migration path exists.

adversarial_cases.input_condition: An imported ValueFlows EconomicEvent directly mutates SAP or TEND.
adversarial_cases.reason: Interoperable facts are not Mycelix authorization, policy or settlement.

adversarial_cases.input_condition: MYCEL recognition is exported as a transferable economic balance.
TEND is translated without exact time units, community scope or zero-sum obligations.
adversarial_cases.reason: The adapter must preserve instrument and accounting semantics.

adversarial_cases.input_condition: Equal resource identifiers from different apps/networks are silently merged.
adversarial_cases.reason: Cross-network identity requires an explicit binding and provenance.

adversarial_cases.input_condition: External API/GraphQL success is presented as DHT validation or settlement evidence.
adversarial_cases.reason: API reachability does not establish validation, authorization or finality.

adversarial_cases.input_condition: A reveal has a mismatching commitment, reused nonce, duplicate identity or invalid phase.
adversarial_cases.reason: Reject tamper/replay but do not infer truth from a valid commitment.

adversarial_cases.input_condition: Conflicting claims or minority verifier results are overwritten or averaged into one truth claim.
adversarial_cases.reason: Disagreement is evidence and must remain auditable.

adversarial_cases.input_condition: Missing, stale, unavailable or unsupported evidence is silently converted into valid/invalid.
adversarial_cases.reason: Unknown is distinct from false and must not silently authorize sensitive actions.

adversarial_cases.input_condition: A build/unit test/listing/demo is presented as multi-agent, audited, production or adoption evidence.
adversarial_cases.reason: Maturity dimensions require separate exact-subject evidence.

adversarial_cases.input_condition: Source code is copied without a pinned revision and compatibility/license review.
adversarial_cases.reason: Architectural learning and source-code reuse are distinct decisions.

adversarial_cases.input_condition: Legacy TEND service-hour field (f32) is exported as exact decimal quantity without an approved quantization/precision profile.
adversarial_cases.reason: Source inspection found TendExchange.hours and cumulative hours are f32. String formatting alone does not make the binary source value exact in the target economic model.

adversarial_cases.input_condition: A TEND position is exported as freely transferable bearer units without preserving community scope, counterparties and service-obligation provenance.
adversarial_cases.reason: TEND is modeled as community-scoped mutual credit; the export must not detach a balance from its underlying obligations.

source_register.use: Stable compatibility tuple; recheck before artifact qualification.
Breaking API/transport changes and no built-in database migration path.
Economic vocabulary, not external authority for Mycelix state.
Project discovery only; listing status is not independent validation.

Source-level observation: TendExchange.hours, TendBalance.total_provided and total_received are f32; TendBalance.balance is i32. This blocks claims of lossless external time-quantity serialization until a precision/quantization profile is specified. This is not a runtime test.
Release claims VF 1.0 + Holochain 0.7.x and provides checksummed DNA/hApp assets; evidence only, not proof of Mycelix integration.

source_revisions_policy: Moving branch URLs are discovery links only. source_revisions pins the exact source commit or release commit inspected. observed_on is the latest matrix refresh, not a claim that every upstream project was re-queried on that date; each observed_maturity_and_compatibility.checked_on is the per-project evidence date. Compatibility/behavior statements remain source-reported until separately reproduced.
